I fixed the typo in `migrations/0007_add_customers.sql`: the column is now `email TEXT NOT NULL`. It was the only `emial` in the repo. I didn't run anything against a database.

An existing EngramDB memory says never to edit an applied migration and to add a new file instead. Your new process overrides it until the release cut, so I left that memory as it is. I saved a new decision memory with your process change, and it notes that the old rule applies again after the cut.

If 0007 has already been applied anywhere, such as a dev or staging database, the column there will still be named `emial`. Those databases will need a rebuild or a manual rename.
